disease_profile.stage: Rai Stage I, diagnosed 18 months ago
disease_profile.treatment_regimen: Watch and wait with 4-month blood draws. Physician discussed that treatment may begin if counts double within 6 months or symptoms worsen.
key_symptoms: Mild fatigue that comes and goes
Two small lymph nodes palpable in the neck
Occasionally wakes up with mild night sweats
disease_profile.trajectory: Stable. Counts have been slowly rising but not dramatically. No infections. Physician is monitoring but has not yet recommended treatment. Patient has been told prognosis is favorable given the slow progression.

causes: Genetics (mother had breast cancer, not CLL but cancer runs in the family)
